decision: Do not integrate either GEMV control
protocol: One full six-leg smoke run per control, both pinned models and all required workloads; separate clean source checkouts and wheel-matched environments; one shared GPU lock covering each build and run.

coalesced.decision: Rejected: BF16 decode is about 41 percent slower than the recorded baseline; Q4 decode also regresses.

serial.decision: Not integrated: the small BF16 differences do not establish a material gain from one run, and Q4 long-context decode was 4.2 percent slower.

local_correctness: Both controls passed 16 matrix-family cases and 20,527,881 assertions on llvmpipe, including the prior wide-output truncation reproducer.
limitations: These smoke runs reject or screen candidates; they are not five-pair acceptance measurements. Exact token identity here means identity with the Linux baseline, not full native Metal identity.
